subject.title: feat(providers): add local Lume macOS leases

question: Should Crabbox adopt and support Lume as a built-in local macOS SSH-lease provider rather than keeping this capability outside the core provider surface?
rationale: This introduces a large new supported provider contract, local VM lifecycle ownership, trusted configuration, and macOS bootstrap behavior; implementation review cannot determine the long-term product commitment alone.

options.title: Sponsor the built-in provider
options.body: Keep the provider in core after the contributor removes the release-owned changelog entry and posts redacted real-host lifecycle evidence.

options.title: Defer the provider contract
options.body: Keep the PR draft while maintainers decide whether local Lume support belongs in the supported built-in provider matrix.

options.title: Prefer an external integration
options.body: Decline the built-in provider direction and invite a narrower external workflow if core support is not intended.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the built-in provider
recommendation.body: Keep the provider in core after the contributor removes the release-owned changelog entry and posts redacted real-host lifecycle evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history shows direct ownership of the current Lume lifecycle and security-hardening design.
